findings.expected: Parse the loan amount using fr-CA conventions (comma decimal separator, space thousands separator), e.g. accept "12 500,50" and "12500,50".
findings.description: The French loan form rejects amounts typed in Canadian French format (12500,50 or 12 500,50), which are within range, and says the amount is out of range. A French user typing a normal French amount cannot submit the form.

findings.expected: Use one term consistently, e.g. "3 opérations récentes" and "Opérations récentes".
findings.description: The same English term "transactions" is translated as "opérations" in the counter and as "Transactions" in the section heading on the same page; "opérations" is the preferred Quebec banking term.

findings.observed: 404 Not Found / Not Found / The requested URL was not found on the server. If you entered the URL manually please check your spelling and try again.
findings.expected: Provide a localized 404 page under /fr/, e.g. "Page introuvable — La page demandée est introuvable. Si vous avez saisi l'adresse manuellement, vérifiez-la et réessayez.", with the site header and lang="fr-CA".
findings.description: An unknown URL under /fr/ shows the framework's default English 404 page, with no French text and no site navigation.
